title: SaaS landing page
summary: A full marketing site for a fictional scheduling app: hero, testimonials, features, pricing with a monthly/yearly toggle, FAQ and footer. Fonts from Google Fonts allowed, nothing else from the network.
watchFor: Typography and spacing: does it feel designed or assembled?
The hero product visual: is it convincing or a grey box?
Does the Monthly / Yearly toggle really change every price?
On the phone video: does the layout reflow, or just shrink?
interaction: Scroll the whole page, open the menu on mobile, switch pricing to Yearly, open an FAQ answer.
